$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (outbound-call-log-investigation-window, Woo row 13.23, decision D5). Merges an investigation window onto `source` (bodyCaptureUntil, bodyCaptureReason, bodyCaptureBy; set by BodyCaptureController, admin only) and the body lifecycle onto `call_log` (bodyCaptured, bodyExpiresAt, bodyExpiredAt, replayRequest). Outgoing call bodies are stored only while the window is open (lib/Outbound/Call/BodyCapturePolicy.php); LogCleanUpTask strips them past bodyExpiresAt and keeps the record. Does NOT edit lib/Settings/integriq_register.json.

bodyCaptureUntil.title: Investigation window until
bodyCaptureUntil.description: Calls to this source store their request and response bodies until this moment. After it, they do not

bodyCaptureReason.title: Investigation reason
bodyCaptureReason.description: Why an administrator opened the investigation window

bodyCaptureBy.title: Investigation opened by
bodyCaptureBy.description: The administrator who last opened or closed the investigation window

bodyCaptured.title: Bodies stored
bodyCaptured.description: Whether this record holds the request and response bodies

bodyExpiresAt.title: Bodies expire at
bodyExpiresAt.description: When the cleanup job removes the bodies and the replay request. The record stays

bodyExpiredAt.title: Bodies removed at
bodyExpiredAt.description: When the cleanup job removed the bodies

replayRequest.title: Replay request
replayRequest.description: The request a failed call sent, secrets redacted, kept so the call can be replayed. Readable only with the replay permission
